skill.name: react-aria-patterns
skill.description: React Aria (Adobe) accessible component patterns for building WCAG-compliant interactive UI with hooks. Use when implementing buttons, dialogs, comboboxes, menus, and other accessible components in React applications.

generated_query: I'm building a React 19 task management app and need an accessible modal dialog for adding a new task. The modal should include a title, a form with a priority combobox (Low, Medium, High) that supports filtering as the user types, and Save/Cancel buttons. Focus must be trapped inside the modal; when it opens, the first focusable element should receive focus automatically. The combobox needs proper keyboard navigation and ARIA roles so screen readers can announce suggestions. Can you help me implement this with the correct patterns?
